script.title: MY LUGGAGE DIDN'T ARRIVE
script.scene_zh: 行李服務台 · 申報延誤
script.story_hook: A traveler's suitcase never arrives at the airport carousel.
script.intro_zh: 旅客的行李箱沒有出現在轉盤上。
script.welcome_en: Welcome back, friends! Today we're reporting delayed luggage.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎回來，朋友們！今天我們要申報延誤的行李。
script.outro: That's our last stop today! Listen and repeat anytime.
script.outro_zh: 今天是我們的最後一站！隨時都能再聽再讀。
script.practice_intro_en: Time to repeat — say each line after me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 跟讀時間到——每一句跟著我唸。
script.char_a_description: a rosy-cheeked woman in her sixties with fluffy white curls, a coral cardigan, beaded reading glasses on a chain, holding a folded paper boarding pass in both hands
script.char_b_description: a patient baggage agent in his twenties with short braided hair, tan slacks, a company cap, and an airline scarf tied neatly at his throat
script.youtube_title: 【🧳行李沒到怎麼辦？】服務台必學對話📦單號申報・應急包・飯店送件🚚一次聽懂｜聽完就會報失｜Delayed Luggage English
script.youtube_title_en: “My Bag Didn't Show Up” — Reporting Delayed Luggage at the Airport
script.youtube_description:
轉盤空空、行李沒下來，站在機場該說什麼？這段服務台對話教你報單號、領應急用品包、留飯店地址請他們送件。18 句美式日常英語附上繁體中文與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，急事也能穩穩用英文處理。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
The carousel stopped and your suitcase never appeared — now what? This baggage-desk dialogue teaches you to file a report, claim an essentials kit, and arrange delivery to your hotel. 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA plus a listen-and-repeat finish. Handle travel hiccups in English.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🧳行李延誤英文｜申報遺失・應急用品包・送件地址｜聽完就會處理｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
轉盤轉了三圈，你的行李箱卻始終沒有出現？
身邊只有一個小側包的當下，該找誰、怎麼說？

這一集帶大家走進機場的行李服務台，跟著旅客從申報遺失、出示辨識聯，到領取應急用品包、留下飯店地址請他們送件，全程都是自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
🧾 申報行李遺失：例如 “My suitcase never came around.”、“Do you still have your claim tag?”。
🎒 領取應急用品：例如 “Let's get you an essentials kit.”、“Toothbrush, socks, and toiletries.”。
🚚 安排送件到府：例如 “We deliver it — what's your hotel address?”、“Text updates will follow.”。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次行李晚點到，記得走向服務台——報個單號，剩下的交給他們，你只要好好休息！
script.thumbnail_action: holding up an orange claim tag

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, my suitcase never came around.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuːz mi maɪ ˈsuːt·keɪs nɛ·vər keɪm əˈraʊnd/
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下，我的行李箱根本沒從轉盤出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'm sorry about that. Which flight were you on?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm ˈsɑ·ri əˈbaʊt ðæt wɪtʃ flaɪt wɜr ju ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 很抱歉。您搭的是哪一班？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Flight four-twelve, and my bag didn't show up.
dialogue.phonetic: /flaɪt fɔr twɛlv ænd maɪ bæɡ dɪ·dənt ʃoʊ ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 412 航班，我的行李沒有出現。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, do you still have your claim tag?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ du ju stɪl hæv jɔr kleɪm tæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 好的，您的行李提領單還在嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðɪs ˈɔ·rɪndʒ stʌb ˈnʌm·bər ˈsɪ·ksti ˈsɛ·vən/
dialogue.zh: 在，就是這張橘色單據——67 號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, that helps us track it fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜr·fɪkt ðæt hɛlps ʌs trækt ɪt fæst/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，這能讓我們快速追蹤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So where is it right now, do you think?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wɛr ɪz ɪt raɪt naʊ du ju θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 那您覺得它現在在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's still at the connecting airport, I'm afraid.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts stɪl æt ðə kəˈnɛk·tɪŋ ˈɛr·ˌpɔrt aɪm əˈfreɪd/
dialogue.zh: 恐怕它還留在轉機的機場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh my. When might it get here?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ maɪ wɛn maɪt ɪt ɡɛt hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 噢，天啊。它什麼時候會到？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most bags land within two days, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst bæɡz lænd wɪˈðɪn tu deɪz ˈɑ·nəst·li/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，多數行李兩天內就會送到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hope so — my medicine is inside, actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hoʊp soʊ maɪ ˈmɛ·də·sən ɪz ɪnˈsaɪd ˈæk·tʃu·ə·li/
dialogue.zh: 希望如此——老實說我的藥在裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then let's get you an essentials kit today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn lɛts ɡɛt ju ən əˈsɛn·ʃə·lɪs kɪt təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那我們今天就先給您一個應急用品包。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What's inside it? That would really help.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌts ɪnˈsaɪd ɪt ðæt wʊd ˈrɪ·li hɛlp/
dialogue.zh: 裡面有什麼？那真的會幫上大忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A toothbrush, socks, a shirt, toiletries.
dialogue.zh: 牙刷、襪子、一件上衣和洗漱用品。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Amazing. Um, how does the bag reach me?
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈmeɪ·zɪŋ ʌm haʊ dʌz ðə bæɡ riːtʃ mi/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。呃，行李要怎麼送到我手上？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We deliver it — what's your hotel address?
dialogue.phonetic: /wi dɪˈlɪ·vər ɪt wʌts jɔr hoʊˈtɛl əˈdrɛs/
dialogue.zh: 我們會直接送——請給飯店地址。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's the Lakeview Inn, 22 Maple Street.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ðə ˈleɪkˌvju ɪn ˈtwɛn·ti tu ˈmeɪ·pəl striːt/
dialogue.zh: 是湖景客棧，楓樹街 22 號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're all set — text updates will follow. Bye!
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr ɔl sɛt tɛkst ʌpˈdeɪts wɪl ˈfɑ·loʊ baɪ/
dialogue.zh: 全部辦好了——訊息會隨時通知您。再見！
